messages:
Elena: Draft RN uploaded for inference rollout. Target deploy 2025-01-20 14:30 UTC. Link: https://docs.internal/rn/infer-v3-draft
Marcus: Quick read. Are we pinning model tag v3.0.0-canary for the initial window?
Elena: Yes. Canary config: 8% traffic for 8h, auto-promote to v3.0.0 if metrics pass.
Priya: Rollback thresholds to include in RN: sustained 5xx >=4% over 10m OR p95 latency >2.5s for 3 consecutive 5m buckets. Also manual rollback if eval prompt set shows quality regressions.
Marcus: Agree. Who is rollback owner?
Elena: Owen will own rollback for first 6h. Owen: I can take it. Rollback command to include in RN:
```
infractl rollback --service=inference --to-tag v2.9.18 --reason "canary_failure"
```
deploybot: Scheduled deploy: 2025-01-20T14:30:00Z. Canary: 8% for 8h. Fallback: v2.9.18.
Priya: Add runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/rollback-inference and telemetry tag rn=infer-v3-canary. Internal announce at T-10m in #eng-releases and #oncall. Customer notify T+3h post-success. Embargo yes.
Marcus: Suggest microcopy tweak for PMs: quantify perf gains -> "expected latency improvement ~7-11% on responses >512 tokens".
Elena: Nice. I'll add that. Owen, please paste minimal post-rollback verification checklist once done.
Owen: Will do — verifying runbook now. If I trigger rollback I'll open #incident-inference, run the checklist, and ping infra lead.
Priya: Final checklist for RN: canary config, thresholds, rollback command, runbook link, telemetry tag, owner, internal+external announce timing. Anyone object to internal announce T-10m?
Marcus: No objections. I'll monitor dashboards at deploy.
Elena: Thanks team. Posting internal preflight at T-10m and pinning this thread for RN archive. :white_check_mark:
